editorial:
Imagine starting your first day at a new job and your boss is a complete loose cannon. That is exactly what happens to Jake, a hopeful rookie cop who wants to make it to narcotics. He gets paired with Detective Alonzo Harris, a legendary cop who seems to know every street corner in LA. At first, you will think Alonzo is just a tough guy who does what it takes to get results. But as the day goes on, you will realize he is actually a criminal in a police uniform. The vibe is tense and sweaty, making you feel like you are riding in that car right along with them.

What really makes this work is Denzel Washington. He is scary, charming, and totally unpredictable. The pacing is great because the pressure just keeps building until the final showdown. If you love movies where a good person has to stand up to a bully, you will love this. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the gritty city details. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for a movie this intense.
endingExplained: Alonzo tries to betray Jake to cover his own tracks, but the neighborhood residents turn against him. They realize he has been playing both sides and refuse to help him. A gang of thugs eventually corners Alonzo in the street. Jake arrives just in time to see Alonzo lose his power. Since Alonzo has no one left to protect him, the gang kills him, and Jake survives as a true cop.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime dramas and strong acting.
